verdict.rationale: Weave's `@weave.op()` decorator automatically captures function inputs, outputs, code and execution metadata into a trace tree, including for OpenAI, Anthropic and other LLM calls. Supported integrations also record token usage and cost per call, shown in the trace tree and calls table. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that latency/duration is captured (only implied by "execution metadata"), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and repo.
